name: Create Password Durable User
summary: Creates the canonical durable user after verified email, complete profile, and password credential establishment.

requiredInputs.description: Reference to the password PendingIdentity being resolved.

guards.expression: pending-identity-flow == password and pending-identity-status == resolution-required and email-ownership == verified and profile-completeness == complete and credential-proof == password-proved and durable-identity in [absent,creation-required]
